先递归建树，同时以列表保存每个节点的左右孩子。这里需要注意递归的过程中会改变全局.en: Build the tree recursively while storing each node's left and right children in a list. Note that recursion would modify global variables, so save the index in a local variable to avoid changes. Then, during BFS, restore the multi-way tree and mirror it at the same time. Using the left-child/right-sibling representation, iterating over children means repeatedly visiting the right sibling of the left child until reaching -1. The problem asks for a mirror image, so during BFS we only need to enqueue all nodes in the current level (the children of the previous node) in reverse order.

另外使用隔离的图鉴版存档验证了完整旅行流程。.en: The complete travel flow was also verified using an isolated Gallery Edition save.

日历按北京时间更新月份，节气料理排在每年的实际节气日期。离线版每月另外随机安排两.en: The calendar updates its month in Beijing time, and solar-term dishes are scheduled on each year's actual solar-term dates. Rewards missed that month can be claimed later; the courtyard shows the calendar only when a reward is available, while the small warehouse keeps a calendar entry. Reclaimable starter gifts share the layout of other rewards in date cells; click the icon to claim.

动态照片1号位的过路照也进行了坐标修复。图鉴版以动态照片教程已完成的状态进入，玩.en: The coordinates of the passing photo in animated-photo slot 1 were also fixed. The Gallery Edition starts with the animated-photo tutorial already completed, so players can open the creation page directly.

新存档预置正式配置中的默认称号「一只蛙的旅行」，旧档缺少这一项时会补齐。首次获得.en: New saves are preset with the default title "A Frog's Journey" from the official configuration; older saves missing this entry will have it filled in. After obtaining the first qualifying travel item, the Travel Encyclopedia selects the exhibit that is actually unlocked. The Plant Encyclopedia updates as the player obtains plants.

工具套装和材料套装可分别用一枚三叶草向嘟嘟购买。小摊的标题与首排商品之间留出空间.en: Tool sets and material sets can each be purchased from Dudu for one clover. Space is left between the stall title and the first row of goods. 旅行返程使用基础 25% 的离线邂逅概率，部分幸运物另有加成。触发时从尚未收集的.en: Return trips use a base 25% offline encounter chance, with additional bonuses from some lucky items. When triggered, a story is chosen from those not yet collected. When a new save receives a gift-box return gift for the first time, it also meets a travel friend and receives the corresponding first-meeting note.

伴蛙前行会从已有旅行、收集和制作记录补进度。官服兑换码与在线小红心在离线版计为完.en: Traveling with Frog backfills progress from existing travel, collection, and crafting records. 许愿池保留最初四次机会。商店的许愿家具礼袋可以用 3000 草重复购买，每次补一.en: The wishing pool keeps its original four chances. The game loading bar plays forward only once, and the landscape-orientation hint uses a larger font. Photo sharing grants qualifying offline rewards and keeps a postcard screen that can be saved as PNG or closed.

本项目围绕《旅行青蛙·中国之旅》的 Android 客户端、静态资源和个人历史存.en: This project builds a locally runnable game save environment around the Android client, static resources, and personal history archives of Travel Frog: A Journey to China. 这样两套游戏可以同时安装、切换和测试，普通版的旅行进度、庭院状态和活动记录不会被.en: In this way, both game versions can be installed, switched, and tested simultaneously, and the Normal Edition's travel progress, courtyard status, and event records will not be overwritten by the Gallery Edition.

图鉴版的定位是“可查看、可试用、可继续互动的完整图鉴”，而不是把普通版的每一次获.en: The Gallery Edition is intended to be "a complete illustrated guide that can be viewed, tried, and further interacted with," rather than forcibly skipping every acquisition process of the Normal Edition. Contents collected at once are unlocked when entering the Gallery Edition: travel gear, furniture, stories, titles, friendship storybooks, handicrafts, encyclopedia, maps, souvenirs, local specialties, museum collections, and fixed travel photos can all be viewed directly.

普通版和图鉴版都将博物馆大冒险、扭蛋机、许愿池作为离线长期入口；它们不会因为原活.en: Both the Normal and Gallery editions offer the Museum Adventure, Gashapon machine, and Wishing Pool as long-term offline access points; they will not disappear when the original event ends. 官服账号密码本身不是存档。官服备份仍需要先保存完整初始化数据，并额外加载相册详情.en: An official-server username and password are not a save file. Backing up official progress still requires capturing the full initialization data and loading album details separately; photo indexes alone cannot guarantee reconstruction of the original compositions. The project page provides a separate guide to enabling capture logs, browsing each module, parsing the data, importing it into the Normal Edition, and restoring the original script.

周年蛋糕的小问答同时核对了客户端实际提交的答案字段。问答现在会正确识别所选项、发.en: The minor Q&A for the anniversary cake also cross-checks the answer fields actually submitted by the client. The Q&A now correctly recognizes the selected options, issues rewards, and advances to the next step; the Normal Edition still retains the sequence of material consumption, phased waiting, crafting, sharing, and claiming rewards.

已有旅行历史的普通版与图鉴版不会被这条规则改写。.en: Normal and Gallery editions with existing travel history will not have this rule overwritten.

图鉴版的抽奖券补齐为与三叶草一致的固定资源：数量始终显示999，商店抽奖不扣减，.en: The lottery tickets in Gallery Edition are filled to match Clover, as a fixed resource: the quantity always shows 999, lottery draws in the shop do not deduct tickets, and white ball returns or other acquisition methods will not further increase it. The Normal Edition still uses the actual number of tickets with consumption rules.

普通版与图鉴版已有的同类照片均已同步迁移，新旅行生成的 dry 场景也会直接使用.en: Matching photos already present in the Normal and Gallery editions have been migrated, and dry scenes generated by new trips will use the correct coordinates directly.

图鉴版任务奖励曾出现“抽奖券实际保持999张，客户端却收到1000张”的数字不一.en: The Gallery Edition task rewards previously had a numerical inconsistency where "the lottery tickets actually remained at 999, but the client received 1000." Now, both the task reward results and lottery ticket push notifications use the fixed number for the Gallery Edition; the return results for duplicate items and calendar rewards also read the final inventory value. The Normal Edition continues to increase according to the actual quantity obtained.

在 CMD 中运行。普通版和图鉴版可独立启动，只玩其中一个时只开对应服务器即可。.en: Run in CMD. Normal and Gallery editions can start independently, and if only playing one, only the corresponding server needs to be launched.

Creating an encyclopedia save, loading flower pots, and normalizing encyclopedia assets now all fill in the pot styles from the configuration. 小仓库日历按钮的提示改用右上角的圆形红点，避免使用带感叹号的图标资源。红点和庭院.en: The hint on the small-warehouse calendar button now uses a round red dot in the upper-right corner instead of an icon carrying an exclamation mark. The dot and the courtyard entrance still share the same check for claimable rewards. Both refresh on day change, on returning to the foreground, and on courtyard sync.

返程明信片的「保存」直接写入游戏相册。打包脚本原先在这个动作之前额外触发了 PN.en: The Save action on return postcards writes directly to the in-game album. The packaging script previously triggered an extra PNG download before that action; this has now been removed. Save in the in-game album details can still export a PNG.

Seasonal dishes can still be claimed later in the same month, but the tasks for earning 30 clovers in total and exchanging prizes in the shop lottery must still be completed; the ad or share conditions are completed automatically by the offline rules. Clicking a locked dish opens the original seasonal detail panel, which shows the current progress and completion marks of the three tasks. The task panel also opens normally when there is no calendar note for that day. When a seasonal dish and a beginner gift fall on the same day, the unlocked seasonal dish is shown first.

日历的日期格和领取判断统一按北京时间处理。跨月时客户端重新读取奖励和任务，旧页面.en: Calendar date cells and claim checks are handled uniformly in Beijing time. When the month changes, the client re-reads rewards and tasks, and claim requests sent from an old page verify the month so that the wrong day’s reward is not claimed.

隔离测试覆盖普通版和图鉴版的11月7日补领、任务未完成、提前领取、重复领取及跨月.en: Isolated tests cover the November 7 late claim in both the standard and encyclopedia editions, incomplete tasks, early claims, duplicate claims, and cross-month requests. The client scripts generated for both editions were also checked for their respective calls to save return photos and export from the album. The local web version and both Windows builds have been regenerated. The courtyard entrance and the red dot are judged separately: the calendar is shown when there is an expired, unclaimed seasonal dish for the month, and the red dot lights up only when the claim conditions are met. The click target on expired cells was fixed, and the November 7 cell was actually clicked in an isolated headless browser, confirming that the home page shows the calendar but no red dot and that the original panel lists three task progress entries.

库插桩可以记录 malloc 的请求大小和返回地址。课件对比预处理宏替换、链接器.en: Library instrumentation can record the requested size of malloc and the return address. The courseware compares preprocessor macro replacement, linker --wrap, and LD_PRELOAD during dynamic loading. Which method to use depends on whether the source code can be modified or re-linked, and whether the observed program calls the target function through dynamic symbols.

Whether program code, libraries, and other regions are randomized depends on the executable and system configuration. Stack randomization only changes where the stack is mapped; addresses of regions such as code may remain fixed. The fixed code address in the courseware is a simplified example.

字级 MUX 用同一个选择信号控制所有位。ALU 也是组合逻辑，结果要写入寄存器.en: A word-level MUX uses the same select signal for all bits. The ALU is also combinational logic, so its result must be written to a register or memory to be retained.

HCL 代码描述的是电路连接与选择关系，而不是顺序执行的程序。case 按优先次.en: HCL code describes circuit connections and selection relationships, not a sequentially executed program. A case selects a single result by priority, and all conditions are compared in parallel in hardware with no need for multiple clocks. Example of a four-way select:

For example, after the input changes from x to y, the output can still hold x until the next rising edge, when it becomes y.

新 PC 从 valP、valC、valM 中选出：ret 用 valM，cal.en: The new PC is selected from valP, valC, and valM: ret uses valM, call and taken jumps use valC, and all other instructions use valP.

这里的 F 包含本周期组合逻辑与相应状态更新；组合信号按数据依赖逐步传播。例如加.en: F here includes this cycle's combinational logic along with the corresponding state updates; combinational signals propagate step by step along data dependencies. For example, a load must first compute its address before it can obtain data from that address.

SEQ 把 PC 更新放在指令处理的末尾；SEQ+ 根据上一条指令留下的结果，在.en: SEQ places the PC update at the end of instruction processing; SEQ+ selects this instruction's PC before fetch, based on the result left by the previous instruction. SEQ+ is still a sequential implementation: moving the PC selection does not make multiple instructions execute at once.

I1 需要五个周期才能完成，但填满后可以每周期完成一条。这是多条指令在不同阶段重.en: I1 takes five cycles to complete, but once the pipeline is full, one instruction can finish each cycle. This is multiple instructions overlapping in different stages, not one ALU executing several instructions at the same instant. PC selection is folded into F's control rather than being a sixth independent pipeline stage.

若后一条指令需要前一条尚未写回的结果，就存在写后读（Read After Wri.en: A read-after-write (RAW) hazard exists when a later instruction needs a result that an earlier instruction has not yet written back.

预测只决定先取哪条指令，不改变 ISA 规定的执行结果。 条件跳转到 E 时，根.en: Prediction only determines which instruction to fetch first; it does not change the execution result required by the ISA. When a conditional jump reaches E, the true e_Cnd is obtained from CC and ifun; instructions on the wrong path must be canceled before they produce program side effects.

这里暂停的是后续取指，不是 ret 自己；否则 ret 无法到 M 取回地址。相.en: What stalls here is subsequent fetching, not ret itself; otherwise ret could not reach M to retrieve its address. Compared with instructions whose next address is known immediately, ret in the basic implementation usually adds three wait cycles.

课件重点分析两种组合。.en: The courseware focuses on two combinations.

对课件这套基本实现，普通可转发的数据相关通常不增加周期；紧邻的 load/use.en: For the courseware's basic implementation, an ordinary forwardable data dependency usually adds no cycles; an adjacent load/use usually adds one cycle; a misprediction adds two; and ret usually adds three. Combined events are counted according to the actual control and cycle table; the individual penalties cannot simply be added together.

比较同容量器件时，教材把 SRAM 的功耗与每位成本列得较高，DRAM 则以较少.en: When comparing devices of the same capacity, the textbook lists SRAM as having higher power consumption and cost per bit, while DRAM trades fewer transistors for higher density. Actual power also depends on the process, access frequency, and standby mode.

DMA 的数据传输不需要 CPU 逐字节搬运，CPU 仍负责发起请求与处理完成事.en: DMA transfers do not require the CPU to move data byte by byte; the CPU still initiates requests and handles completion events. Data entering main memory and data finally being read into registers by a program are different steps.

机械盘读写要等待寻道和旋转。SSD 没有这些机械部件，通常具有较低的随机访问延迟.en: Mechanical disks must wait for seek and rotation on reads and writes. SSDs have no such mechanical parts and usually offer lower random-access latency, better shock resistance, and less operating noise, and they are easier to make in smaller form factors. Price per capacity and write endurance must be compared in light of the device and workload.

CPU、主存与外部存储的速度差异，意味着减少慢层访问往往十分重要；课件历史趋势图.en: The speed gap between the CPU, main memory, and external storage means reducing slow-layer accesses is often important; the courseware's historical trend graph illustrates this gap.

外部函数调用可能修改全局状态。即使函数参数相同，返回值也可能因为全局变量或静态变.en: An external function call may modify global state. Even with the same arguments, its return value may differ because global or static variables changed. The compiler therefore cannot freely delete, merge, or move function calls.

Symbols explicitly marked weak in ELF have their own binding rules. The linker can match symbol names, but the program must still ensure that C types declared across modules agree.

构建时可用 ar rcs libvector.a addvec.o multve.en: At build time, ar rcs libvector.a addvec.o multvec.o creates a static library, and ar t lists its members. Shared libraries are usually compiled with -fPIC and produced with gcc -shared. A NEEDED entry written into the executable at link time tells the loader which libraries are needed at run time. dlopen is initiated by an already running program, and dlsym returns a callable function address or data address.

库插桩可以记录函数的参数和返回值。编译时用宏改写调用点。链接时用 GNU ld.en: Library instrumentation can record a function's arguments and return value. At compile time, macros rewrite call sites. At link time, GNU ld's --wrap redirects undefined references to foo to __wrap_foo, while __real_foo inside the wrapper points to the real implementation. At load time, setting LD_PRELOAD for the current program lets the dynamic loader prefer the wrapper implementation, and the wrapper can use dlsym with RTLD_NEXT to reach the next definition. This year's slides cover compile-time instrumentation on pages 59-60, load-time instrumentation on pages 61-63, and summarize all three approaches on page 64.

对应今年第 16 讲课件《Exceptional Control Flow I》.en: This corresponds to this year's Lecture 16 slides, "Exceptional Control Flow I", and textbook §8.1-8.4. This lecture covers how an instruction enters the kernel when an event occurs, and how the kernel lets multiple processes each continue executing.

顺序执行、跳转、call 和 ret 都按程序指令选取后续 PC。定时器到期、磁.en: Sequential execution, jumps, call, and ret all select the next PC according to program instructions. A timer expiring, a disk read completing, a page fault, and a system call also change where execution continues, but they are triggered by events and the processor hands control to a kernel entry point. The kernel saves the state needed to continue; after handling, it can retry the current instruction, continue with the next one, or end the current control flow.

异常号用于选择对应的异常入口。Linux x86-64 的 syscall 指令.en: The exception number selects the corresponding exception entry. Linux x86-64's syscall instruction uses a dedicated kernel entry, and the kernel then finds the service by the system call number in %rax. Arguments go in %rdi, %rsi, %rdx, %r10, %r8, and %r9 in order, and the result is returned in %rax. Note that the fourth argument is %r10, while the System V calling convention for ordinary C functions usually uses %rcx for the fourth. The C library wrapper generally converts a negative kernel error code into -1 and sets errno.

缺页说明当前访问不能直接通过地址转换。地址合法时，内核可建立映射、从磁盘调页或处.en: A page fault means the current access cannot pass address translation directly. If the address is valid, the kernel can establish a mapping, page in from disk, or handle copy-on-write, then retry the original instruction. If the address has no valid mapping and cannot be fixed, the process usually receives SIGSEGV. An out-of-bounds array access is undefined behavior in C, and whether it triggers a hardware fault also depends on whether the containing page is accessible.

Fault 重试时，会用恢复后的现场重新执行原指令。修好缺页映射可以使重试成功。.en: When a fault is retried, the original instruction executes again with the restored state. Fixing the page-fault mapping can make the retry succeed. If the divisor of an integer divide-by-zero is still zero, returning to the original location triggers the exception again. Whether recovery is possible depends on whether the condition that caused the fault has been removed.

进程是程序的一次运行实例，有 PID、当前执行位置和私有虚拟地址空间。同一个程序.en: A process is one running instance of a program, with a PID, a current execution position, and a private virtual address space. The same program can be started many times. The context is the state a process needs to continue later, including the PC, registers, stack pointer, flags, and kernel-managed stack, scheduling, and address-space information. When switching, the kernel saves the old process's context, selects a runnable process, and restores its state.

数值是子进程 PID.en: The value is the child's PID

从同一条 fork 调用之后继续.en: Continues after the same fork call

父子有各自的虚拟地址空间。私有可写内存通常先共享物理页，写入时再复制。继承的文件.en: Parent and child have separate virtual address spaces. Private writable memory is usually shared as physical pages first and copied on write. Inherited file descriptors can refer to the same open file and therefore may share the file offset. The local variable x on pages 39 and 42 has a copy in each process after fork: the parent decrements it to 0 and -1, while the child increments it to 2 and 3.

wait(&status) 回收任意一个可回收的子进程，成功时返回子 PID。.en: wait(&status) reaps any one reapable child and returns the child's PID on success.

waitpid(pid, &status, 0) 等指定孩子。孩子还没结束时会等.en: waitpid(pid, &status, 0) waits for a specific child. It waits while that child has not finished, even if other children are already reapable.

WIFEXITED 成立后读 WEXITSTATUS，WIFSIGNALED 成.en: After WIFEXITED holds, read WEXITSTATUS; after WIFSIGNALED holds, read WTERMSIG. status is an encoded status value.

execve(path, argv, envp) 成功后替换当前进程的程序映像，.en: execve(path, argv, envp) replaces the current process's program image on success, keeping the PID; execution does not continue at the original call site. On failure it returns -1.

shell 启动外部命令的常见流程是父进程 fork，子进程 execve，父进.en: The usual flow for the shell to start an external command is: the parent forks, the child calls execve, and the parent calls waitpid as needed. Both argv and envp end with a null pointer, and environment strings look like PATH=/usr/bin. The new program can obtain arguments and the environment from the initial stack. Open descriptors are usually preserved, while descriptors marked close-on-exec are closed.

对应今年第 17 讲课件《Exceptional Control Flow: S.en: This corresponds to this year's Lecture 17 slides, "Exceptional Control Flow: Signals and Nonlocal Jumps", and textbook §8.5-8.6. This lecture addresses two questions: how a process handles asynchronous events notified by the kernel, and how a function escapes a deep call stack.

信号是用小整数 ID（1–30）标识的通知，表示系统里发生了某类事件，由内核发给.en: A signal is a notification identified by a small integer ID (1-30) indicating that some type of event occurred in the system; the kernel sends it to a process, and another process can call the kill system call to ask the kernel to send one. Signals carry no information beyond the ID.

强制杀死，不能覆盖或忽略.en: Forced termination; cannot be caught or ignored

进程对信号的三种反应是忽略、终止（可带 core dump）、或执行用户安装的处.en: A process can respond to a signal in three ways: ignore it, terminate (optionally with a core dump), or run a user-installed handler. Each signal has a predefined default action: terminate, terminate with core dump, stop until SIGCONT, or ignore.

handler 执行期间可以被其他信号打断。内核隐式屏蔽与当前正在处理的信号同类.en: A handler can be interrupted by other signals while it runs. The kernel implicitly blocks pending signals of the same type as the one being handled, so signals of that type do not nest. Explicit blocking uses sigprocmask with a sigset_t: sigemptyset, sigfillset, sigaddset, and sigdelset build the set, and SIG_BLOCK, SIG_UNBLOCK, and SIG_SETMASK modify the mask. The blocked set is also called the signal mask; execve inherits the current mask.

handler 必须在信号可能到达之前安装。fork 之后父进程立刻 kill.en: A handler must be installed before a signal can arrive. If the parent calls kill immediately after fork, the child may not yet have executed the registration statement, so the signal takes its default action and is lost; register first, then fork.

尽量简单，例如只置一个全局标志就返回。.en: Keep it as simple as possible, for example setting a global flag and returning.

进入时保存 errno，退出前恢复。.en: Save errno on entry and restore it before returning.

访问共享数据结构时临时屏蔽所有信号，防止更新到一半被打断。.en: Temporarily block all signals while accessing shared data structures to prevent an update from being interrupted halfway.

fork 之后父子谁先运行不确定。fork 前屏蔽 SIGCHLD，父进程把子进.en: After fork, it is uncertain whether the parent or child runs first. Block SIGCHLD before fork, have the parent register the child in the job table and then unblock it, and have the child restore the inherited mask before execve. This way SIGCHLD cannot arrive before registration is complete.

sigsetjmp/siglongjmp 额外保存与恢复信号屏蔽集，在 hand.en: sigsetjmp/siglongjmp additionally save and restore the signal mask; jumps from a handler must use this pair. A fault-type signal such as SIGFPE has terminate as its default action, and installing a handler lets the process take over; but if the handler returns normally, the faulting instruction retries and raises the same signal again. To truly continue, the handler must siglongjmp elsewhere or simply terminate the process.

信号是进程级的异常处理，非本地跳转是进程内的异常控制流。.en: Signals are process-level exception handling; nonlocal jumps are intra-process exceptional control flow.
